articles.title: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks 35% as $1.5 billion exits reserves after illicit-finance report
articles.snippet: USDS held its $1 peg as a large holder linked to Poloniex withdrew much of decentralized protocol Sky's USDC liquidity backing its stablecoins.

articles.title: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system, putting billions at freeze risk
articles.snippet: Blockchain investigation traced $518 million in illicit-linked activity, including the 2025 Bybit hack, through a key reserve backing DAI and USDS tokens, putting Sky's institutional finance ambitions and open design on collision course.
